secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL). Required for database, auth, and admin CMS.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public key (Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → anon key). Paired with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key (Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → service_role key). Server-only; needed for admin CMS operations.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for transactional email (Resend dashboard → API Keys). Optional — only needed for lead notification emails.

secrets.name: EMAIL_FROM
secrets.description: From-address for transactional email, e.g. 'AJS Technology <onboarding@resend.dev>'. Optional.

secrets.name: EMAIL_ADMIN_TO
secrets.description: Admin inbox to receive lead notification emails. Optional.
